title: MMP architecture contribution opened
detail: Dominik's glossary, ADRs and open questions entered through PR #1 and were merged.

title: Information classification contribution
detail: Mark's static/dynamic information classification entered through PR #2 and was merged.

title: Work packages added
detail: Repository README gained Data Acquisition, UX, System Architecture, QA and Deployment/GTM work packages.

title: Pipeline concept docs committed
detail: Adaptive ingestion, provenance, municipality benchmark, service model and build plan were added under pipeline/.

title: Pipeline semantic-compiler PR opened
detail: PR #3 proposes HTTP-first runtime, browser escalation, OSS tooling choices and large-planner/small-Apertus execution.

title: Living observatory PR opened
detail: PR #4 introduced the first static build-state dashboard.

title: Scraper prototype opened
detail: PR #5 adds the first executable slice: bounded HTTP crawl, snapshots, PageIR, heuristic detection and a model adapter.

title: Observatory widened to project scope
detail: The dashboard integrated repository-wide project streams and Git metadata while keeping pipeline/observatory as the only write location.

title: PR #3 and #4 merged
detail: Semantic compiler / runtime docs and the observatory landed on main.

title: README clarification opened
detail: PR #6 clarifies project, pipeline and pilot municipalities in the root README.

title: Scrapping baseline tooling on main
detail: Service, source, municipality and crawl-report schemas, a provenance validator and browser capture helpers were committed.

title: Crawler hardened
detail: PR #7 grows the prototype test suite from 3 to 11 passing tests: URL normalization, redirects, model fallback, tourism negatives.

title: First Service Inventory handoff
detail: PR #8 defines mmp-service-inventory/v0 and ships a seed batch: 26 services from 22 official sources across 7 of 8 municipalities.

title: Architecture restructured into six stages
detail: The observatory modelled the system as Discover → Compile → Verify → Serve → Experience, with Operate spanning all stages and a seven-level maturity scale per module.

title: Handoff merged and aligned with minigmeind
detail: PR #8 merged. A capability matrix maps inventory capabilities onto Patrick's live minigmeind MCP (~31 tools, dummy data).

title: OpenAI API calling set up
detail: Patrick added the openai client, a .env setup and scripts/test_openai.py calling gpt-6-luna.

title: Boundary shifted to Service Leads
detail: docs/pipeline-service-lead-boundary rewrites 7 pipeline docs: Agent 1 discovers services and source bundles; Agent 2 compiles each into a local MCP capability plan. Normalization becomes optional.

title: Observatory redrawn around four blocks
detail: Discovery → Service Compiler → MCP Builder → Citizen Experience, with the handoff artifacts between them (Service Leads, capability plan, village MCP) and Trust wrapping the chain.
